reviews.text: There simply isn't another clinic like Veterinari del Clínic. Every single person on the team truly puts their 100% in what they do. The level of knowledge, passion and care is truly unmatched and the way they explain things to the owners is really outstanding. You really couldn't leave your furry family in better hands!

Went for my first vet visit with my dog Curtis and his vet Dr.Alberto is amazing. He was extremely helpful in checking him out and getting us registered in Catalunya. Im also thankful we were able to switch to english without any issues, it shows how much they priotise pet health.
I just left the clinic with my cat, and the treatment, patience, and professionalism were outstanding. I couldn't be more grateful.

We are very happy with the entire team at the Clinic and the way they have always treated Guinness.

Above all, we want to thank Gala for everything she does for her. She is always attentive, incredibly caring, and treats her as if she were her own. Thanks to Gala, she regained the weight she needed, she has had all the necessary tests done, and we are now monitoring her because she has lost a little weight again. It's very reassuring to have a veterinarian who cares so much for her.

Marta spayed her, and everything went perfectly. The surgery went very well, and Guinness recovered wonderfully.

Alberto and Vero have had to treat her in emergencies a few times, and as soon as they see her come through the door, they know she's probably eaten something. They always greet her with lots of affection and, of course, with a treat in hand.

Raquel is always ready to play with her and chase her around the clinic. She's also the one who always manages to draw blood, which is quite an achievement considering how restless Guinness is. And the best part is that, despite everything, Guinness is always happy to see her.

And Javi, the groomer, takes care of her baths and trimming her nails. He always tells us she's very well-behaved, although we have our doubts.

Thank you all so much for taking such good care of Guinness and for the love you always show her.

It was my first time visiting a veterinary clinic, and this was the one Google recommended. I arrived without an appointment, but they treated me very well! The team is very friendly, especially Alberto, who was with me throughout the entire process. This will definitely be my go-to clinic!

We have tried to locate your information in our database, but the name associated with this review does not show any visit, and we cannot identify you as a client of our clinic.

We would like to understand what happened and personally review your experience. If you visited Veterinari del Clínic, we would appreciate it if you could contact us by phone or email, indicating the name of the patient or the name of the registered owner as it appears in our system.

We would be happy to hear from you and clarify any situation that may have caused this dissatisfaction.

Sincerely,

The Veterinari del Clínic Team

This is the vet clinic we visit regularly  since May 2025, since we have been residing in Spain.

This year, we have visited it twice for the annual vaccination and another issue. Our dog Jeraldine is in love with our wonderful vet Gala. We are super happy with everything and grateful for the attitude and care our dog receives here.

Last summer we visited it twice. The review is as follows:

My wife and I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.
We've done a general check-up and annual vaccinations for our dog here:
+ our doctor Marta speaks perfect English, made the check-up of our dog very attentively and thoroughly, answered all our questions very professionally;
+ there were no side effects following the vaccinations, our dog felt super well;
+ all other staff spoke English well too, they advised us on issuing the EU pet passport for our dog.
Thank you very much!

I'm so happy with Veterinari del Clínic and the whole team. As a dachshund mom, it's so important to me to take her somewhere I know they know her, treat her with so much love, and where I can completely trust them.

They always treat us wonderfully, explain everything clearly, and have endless patience with her. You can really see the care they put into their work and how well they know each animal.

It's so reassuring to have a trusted vet you know you can go to for anything and know that Inedit is in good hands.

Thank you for always taking such good care of her ❤️🐾
Thank you !

I've decided to change veterinary clinics because this one is only interested in making money and doesn't care about animal welfare. Between the bad reviews and my own experience, I think we made the right decision.

If you have any questions about the filters, you can choose "most recent" reviews, and you can also filter by the number of stars. It's astonishing that no one has reported them to the veterinary association.
Excellent veterinarians! I've been to many in Barcelona, ​​and this is undoubtedly the best. They check everything that needs to be checked, give you good advice, highly recommended!

We took our dog in because she had some whitish, odorless discharge during her heat cycle. On the first call, we were told that one possibility was pyometra, but the appointment they offered was for the following Tuesday. When we called again (because I insisted), another person got us an appointment for Saturday of that same week.

What raised our suspicions was that the person who finally saw us was the same one we had spoken to on that first call. Therefore, we don't understand why it was initially considered appropriate to wait several days for the appointment and then they insisted that it was an urgent situation requiring surgery as soon as possible.

Before going, we were also informed that the veterinarian wasn't an ultrasound specialist, although he could take a look and offer some guidance. That's why we agreed. During the ultrasound, he told us he wasn't sure what he saw and noted several possibilities in the report. After blood work, we received a presumptive diagnosis of pyometra and were advised to have our dog spayed urgently.

Furthermore, some details in the report didn't match what we had explained. We mentioned seeing whitish drops on the floor, not fluid coming from the vulva. We also clarified several times that the initial odor came from the fur in the area and disappeared after bathing her, not from the fluid, but it was still listed as a symptom.

Since our dog didn't present the typical symptoms of pyometra and we didn't want to subject her to surgery without a clear diagnosis, we went to another veterinarian. This one also performed an ultrasound and, based on both what he observed and his experience with numerous cases of pyometra, indicated that our dog didn't have the typical appearance or signs of this disease. Even so, to put our minds at ease, he referred us to a trusted veterinarian for a third ultrasound to confirm the diagnosis.

At that clinic, they explained the ultrasound procedure in detail and how to differentiate pyometra from other conditions. The conclusion was that our dog didn't have pyometra, but rather findings consistent with being in heat and some isolated cysts, recommending follow-up and ultrasound monitoring.

Between the consultation, ultrasound, blood work, and medication for 7 days, we paid €244. Hmm. We had to ask the price of the blood work before authorizing it, and at no point were we informed of the cost of the medication (or the blood work). Furthermore, we received the report, but not the ultrasound images.

If we had been certain that our dog had urgent pyometra, we would have authorized the surgery without hesitation. Before her, we had another dog with cancer who lived with us for 17 years, and our current dog grew up alongside her. We have always done everything possible for our animals, so our decision wasn't to avoid surgery, but to ensure a clear diagnosis before subjecting her to major surgery.

We also felt uncomfortable when, after explaining that we were in the middle of moving and wanted to think things through before making such an important decision, we perceived expressions of disapproval from the veterinarian. He probably didn't do it intentionally, but that was the impression we got at the time.

We understand that diagnostic uncertainty can exist, but given that during the ultrasound we were told there wasn't complete certainty about what was being observed and that the person who performed it wasn't a qualified sonographer, we would have thought it more prudent to recommend another ultrasound with a specialist before considering urgent surgery.

I went there without an appointment to get a passport done at the last minute and they treated me with absolute professionalism and kindness.

I leave more than grateful. I have a lot of confidence now!
They take care of your pet like nowhere else I've tried! Marta is amazing at taking care of our kittens!

We had a great experience at the clinic! Our cat Toru had a dental cleaning and a tooth extraction, and we are very grateful for the care, attention, and kindness he received throughout the whole process.

A special thank you to Marta and Alberto for taking such good care of him. ❤️

Toru also sends his biggest thank you! 🐾

Dr. Alberto and the team are the best vets in Barcelona! We worked with three other vets in the area who were mostly unkind and sent no updates, reminders, or communication about care, all of which was multiplied by treating immigrant clients poorly. But Veterinari del Clinic? Not the case. So thoughtful and respectful and great people to care for your pets. Can’t recommend enough!

I want to thank Marta, Gala, and Raquel for their warmth and professionalism in treating Noa. I truly appreciate their follow-up: they call, ask questions, and are genuinely attentive. Their professional and technical skills are excellent; they explain everything clearly, honestly, and with great tact. They have always been attentive and caring. For this and so much more, our family will always be grateful to have you, especially Noa 💜.
Thank you for your feedback, best regards.

A terrible experience. I arrived with my 16-year-old dog in very bad shape; she was dying. They recommended hospitalization, tests, analyses, a whole lot of things, when I would have appreciated a recommendation for gentle sedation. It lasted three terrible hours, with us being rushed around in those vulnerable moments. It wasn't the ending I wanted, and they didn't advise me properly. In those difficult times, I would have preferred to have her sedated and spend her last moments with her, as there was nothing else to do but wait for the end.
Thank you so much for your feedback!

Words cannot express our gratitude to the entire team at El Clínic, located at 157 Casanova Street in Barcelona, ​​for the love, dedication, and compassion with which they cared for our dog all these years.

From day one, they made us feel she was in the best hands, but it was especially during the most difficult moments that they demonstrated the immense humanity behind each and every one of you. You accompanied her with love, respect, and boundless sensitivity until the very last moment of her life, helping us face such a painful farewell with a gentleness we will never forget.
Every gesture, every word of support, and the beautiful gift you gave us at the end meant so much more than you can imagine. In the midst of our sadness, we felt accompanied, understood, and comforted.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for caring for her with so much love and for giving us the peace of mind of knowing she was surrounded by extraordinary people until the very end. We will always be grateful and will always carry you in our hearts.

Excellent care for my dog, friendly and professional staff. @Alberto has always been very attentive to any problems my dog ​​has, and he follows up to see if his symptoms have improved.

Marta is a good surgeon who performed the castration operation on my dog, even though he had an undescended testicle, and everything went perfectly.

The reception staff are also very nice, like Raquel and others.

I 100% recommend this clinic for your pets. 💯
The best vet in the world. I've been to many, and none like this one. Thanks to Gala and Raquel for everything!

We couldn't be more grateful to this veterinary clinic and its entire team. Our Basset Hound, Abbey, has been treated here on several occasions, including various surgeries that, thankfully, were never serious, but were always performed with immense professionalism and care.

We especially want to highlight the attention to detail, the thoroughness of each visit, and the incredible kindness of veterinarians Gala and Marta, who have always instilled confidence and peace of mind in us. Their love and dedication to each animal is evident.

Furthermore, the post-operative care has always been excellent: constant monitoring, attention to every detail, and availability for any questions or needs.

Without a doubt, this is a completely trustworthy clinic that we wholeheartedly recommend to anyone who wants the best for their pet and wants to feel supported and secure at all times.

Excellent service and great professionalism. The team is very friendly, always explains everything clearly, and treats our dog Milu with great care. They inspired confidence from the very first moment, and the follow-up is impeccable. Without a doubt, a highly recommended veterinary clinic.

The best veterinarian in Barcelona! Always super attentive and friendly (all the staff who work there). Gala has extensive knowledge and is very up-to-date with the treatments and management of veterinary pathologies. I took my dog ​​for a second opinion here because she wasn't improving with the treatment they were giving her at another veterinarian. From the first visit they listened to my concerns and knew how to care for and cure her. They provide very close and personalized follow-up. Very grateful for the treatment received, I highly recommend them!
Such a kind and caring vet, they have always been helpful and willing to listen to your concerns. Our pup is always very happy to go and loves all the staff.

We are very happy with them.

What I value most is that they listen, are attentive, and genuinely care about their patients. They know Hook perfectly, as he is a reactive dog, and they always keep this in mind during each visit to make the experience as stress-free as possible for him <3

They have a quiet room where he can relax, and, something that has made a huge difference for us, they allow us to stay with the dog at all times. When they had to sedate him, they let us stay with him in a dimly lit room until he fell asleep. This is the fourth vet Hook has seen, and we had never been allowed to stay with him like this before.

His vet, Alberto, is friendly and very attentive. After years of consultations, tests, and back-and-forth visits, he was one of the first to truly take Hook's pain, digestive, and behavioral problems seriously. Thanks to his recommendations, including the referral to an ethologist, we have seen significant improvements in Hook's daily life.

Furthermore, they provide excellent follow-up: they call to check on him, arrange appointments with other clinics when necessary, and make everything incredibly easy. We've always felt they study each case individually and strive for what's best for Hook.

We also greatly appreciate their honesty. Once, I called to schedule an appointment with a nutritionist, and Alberto called me personally to tell me that, in our case, it wasn't necessary. He gave me some guidelines, and that was it. It's so refreshing to find professionals who prioritize the animal's well-being above all else.

And while I've mentioned Alberto, the truth is, the entire team is wonderful. In fact, one of the things that makes me happiest is that Hook loves going to the vet. He always goes in happy, greeting everyone and seeking affection. For a reactive dog like him, that speaks volumes about how they make him feel there :).

In short, we feel they truly care about their patients and the people who accompany them. After so many years searching for answers, finding a team like this gives us immense peace of mind. Thank you for taking such good care of Hook.
Thank you for your feedback. Best regards.
Thank you for your feedback. Best regards.

I want to thank Dr. Marta for the excellent work she did with my dog ​​Giulio, a French Bulldog, during his BOAS surgery. From the very first consultation, she demonstrated great professionalism, experience, and the ability to explain every detail of the procedure, instilling a great deal of confidence and peace of mind in us.

The surgery was a success, and the results have been extraordinary. The postoperative follow-up was impeccable, with constant attention and great care at every stage of his recovery.

Today, Giulio is much better: he breathes easily, has much more energy, sleeps peacefully, and no longer snores at night. The improvement in his quality of life has been impressive.

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Marta and the entire team. Thank you so much for your dedication, professionalism, and love for animals.

Thank you so much for always taking such good care of Abril, whether it's a visit, an emergency, or surgery, we always leave feeling completely at ease! A huge thank you to Marta and the whole team who are always so attentive and for the kindness with which you treat us! You are the best!
Raquel provided excellent service! We called to ask a question, and I was delighted with her warmth and dedication. We will definitely be taking our cats to them.
Thank you so much for your feedback!

I went to this vet because he had very good reviews and I think it's not entirely fair.
I ask for an appointment and when I go there they tell me that my animal has a foreign body and that he needs an ultrasound.
The foreign body is obvious to the vet, who even touches it with his hand.
At that time they can't do the ultrasound and they do an X-ray to confirm the foreign body. The price of the X-ray is 85 euros, when in most places it is much lower. They also make us do a blood test (139) that they say we will need later. But to sweep home they make us do it there.
They send us to a hospital that I wouldn't go back to either

When we get to the hospital, they make us do an ultrasound. So between one and the other we end up doing more tests than we should.
In total we spend more than 500 euros in both centers.
They give us a budget of 2800 that we do not accept and we end up operating satisfactorily on our dog for 1200 in another center.

The care is correct, but when you have a problem with your animal you look for a professional who is good and also does what is right for you, no more, and at a fair price.
The review has one star for the price, for the recommendation of the hospital and because you would not have gone to this place if it did not have a 4.9.
I would go to a small veterinarian where the main objective was not to make money

I am grateful that the two veterinarians who attended to us have been concerned about our little dog

The care of the staff is good and they look after the pet and its well-being, not so much for its owners.
You will end up paying a high price that is not suitable for all pockets.

We thank you from the bottom of our hearts for the year and a half that you have spent with Nuka and with us, helping us fight and make life better for our dog, Nuka. Thank you very much for your professionalism and for the beautiful words you have written to us. A big hug and see you soon.
Thank you for your feedback, best regards.

Bimbo and I are very happy with the entire team at the Clinic Veterinarian. The treatment is excellent and very friendly, and Bimbo loves going there, without any fear, which we appreciate very much.

They are very attentive professionals, they solve all doubts clearly and always advise us on the best for his health. You can tell they are dedicated and that they love animals. Totally recommended!

We couldn't be happier that we chose this veterinary clinic. They treated our dog Rayo with a professionalism and kindness that we hadn't found at our previous clinic. They are very caring and perfectly understand each pet's individual needs. I wholeheartedly recommend their services.

A very good place. Not only I am completely satisfied with their service, but my dog Thor loves the place so much, that every time we pass by he starts wagging his tail, pulling towards it and is very disappointed when we don't go there
Great experience with Dr. Gala. The staff was very attentive and friendly! ☺️

We had previously trusted this clinic and even chose them for our cat’s spaying, so both we and our cat felt safe here. However, today’s experience seriously changed our perception.

A week ago, we booked a grooming appointment with Laura due to matting issues. When we arrived today, we were unexpectedly attended by a different male groomer. Unfortunately, his approach was extremely forceful and distressing. He restrained our cat with excessive physical pressure and brushed her in such a harsh way that, for the first time, I heard her hiss and cry, which she had never done before. There was a complete lack of gentleness or compassion — at one point, he was even pulling her leg and tail while trying to remove mats with a comb.

Because my Spanish is limited, I struggled to intervene properly, and I did not want to leave my cat alone in that situation. I felt trapped and unable to step away to ask for help, which made the experience even more distressing. It was honestly a frightening experience. Eventually, the veterinarian came, and I tried to explain the situation calmly. We decided to stop the grooming, paid, and left immediately with our cat.

What I cannot understand is how such a professional-looking clinic can employ someone who handles animals in such a rough and distressing manner.

This review is not about the veterinary care itself, but about allowing this kind of treatment during grooming. Watching someone pull out mats from my cat while she looked at me in fear was heartbreaking and completely unacceptable.

I just want to say that it's been a pleasure leaving Norte in such good hands. Thanks to Gala and the whole team for the great work they do, and for conveying that trust and warmth. A highly recommended place.

We came from Korea looking for a safe place for my cats, and a friend recommended Dr. Alberto! He was always very attentive to my kitten, they did the basics, and with the results, we gave her some pills, and my cat is perfect!! She had asthma symptoms, but with the gentle treatment, without overdoing it with blood tests, etc., she doesn't have any more asthma symptoms! Thank you so much!

I have a nearly 8-year-old dog with some health conditions. The vet who was treating him left the clinic, and we decided to look for another place to continue his care.
After an initial visit of almost two hours, during which she gave him a very thorough check-up and performed an ultrasound with us present (which other clinics don't allow), she explained everything very well and even quickly noticed things I hadn't mentioned! Gala seemed very attentive and professional. Even after the visit, I was able to contact her to discuss ideas and ask questions. We will definitely continue with her. My dog ​​is part of the family, and as such, we will always seek the best for him so that he can be with us for a long time!

Very good treatment, they dedicated all the necessary time to explain to me the problem my cat has that has been dragging for a long time and other vets had not given me a solution. Finally we can find a solution, I am very grateful
Excellent service, they are all very professional, kind to us as first-timers and affectionate with Kira who always comes to say hello whenever we are in the area 🐶. …

Excellent experience at Veterinari del Clinic!
Alberto and Laura were very kind, patient, and professional. They took blood samples and did an X-ray with great care, especially considering how sensitive my pet is. They really try to find the best approach to avoid stress and pain. 🙏

Thank you for your genuine care and attention — highly recommended!

I will be eternally grateful to the veterinarian at the Clinic! I recommend it without hesitation. This clinic boasts state-of-the-art equipment, which is evident in the speed and accuracy of the diagnosis. However, what truly stands out is the exceptional care and compassion of the team.

I want to especially thank veterinarian Marta Olivella. She is an outstanding professional who, along with the entire staff, is completely dedicated to her work. It's clear they approach it with admirable passion, competence, and kindness.

Thanks to their intervention and professionalism, they saved my cat's life, and that's something I will never forget. If you're looking for a trustworthy place where your pets are treated with the utmost respect and the best technology, this is the place. My cats couldn't be in better hands.

My regular vet for over a year now.
Excellent care from the whole team, and especially Alberto, who always greets my dog ​​with all the love in the world. I recommend him 100% ♥️🫂 …
Thank you so much for your feedback. We're happy to assist you whenever you need us.
Thank you so much for your feedback, we appreciate your trust.
I highly recommend this veterinary clinic; they provide excellent service and are very professional.

I took my dog ​​Leo to the clinic after another center couldn't diagnose what was wrong with him. There, they interpreted the tests completely differently, and we were able to start treatment. I want to highlight the kindness of all the staff and the attention given by Marta and Gala, both during the visits and the follow-up phone calls to check on his progress at home. They always gave us a prompt appointment and dedicated the necessary time to examine Leo, determine what might be wrong, answer our questions, and talk to us openly.

Thank you for the attention, explanations and treatment received. Speed ​​in the whole process.
Many thanks to Alberto and the whole team

The service I received was 10 out of 10. They provide personalized care for my two cats, which I absolutely loved 😊.
There was even a time when we had a minor incident with one of my cats, and they provided impeccable follow-up and care.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic!

My experience at Veterinari del Clínic has been excellent. From the very first moment, I received very friendly and professional service. I especially want to highlight the work of Gala, who showed exceptional, kind, and careful care towards Nina. Without a doubt, a highly recommended service.

From the first call, I knew I'd found the right place. We don't live in Barcelona, ​​and we contacted them looking for a good orthopedic surgeon for our 14-year-old dog. The telephone service was excellent. I spoke with several assistants, each one more attentive and kind than the last. The orthopedic surgeon, Albert Farrés, is a model of professionalism and honesty. He accepted all the diagnostic tests performed at our usual vet, which is much appreciated because it saves us a lot of money. He also advised us to see a neurologist, which we have already done. Any questions we had after the visit were always answered with kindness and professionalism, something we greatly appreciate when dealing with situations where worry and fear take over. I have no doubt that they would be the vets for my three dogs and two cats if we lived in Barcelona, ​​but I certainly know where to go when my regular vet clinic doesn't have the necessary resources. We are very grateful.
Gala, Albert, and Marta are the best!

My experience with Veterinari del Clínic has been excellent from start to finish. Since moving to Barcelona from San Francisco, California, it was very easy to schedule an evaluation appointment for our dogs, as well as transfer their records for follow-up (even in English).

The staff is highly qualified, friendly, and very empathetic, even in the most difficult moments. Marta, one of the lead veterinarians, is very professional, intelligent, and attentive. She has a great deal of patience and always strives to do what's best for the health and well-being of the animals.

Likewise, the administrative staff is patient, competent, and very well-coordinated; they always provide excellent follow-up. María is the person I've interacted with the most, and she has always greeted us with a smile. Raquel and the other women are also very professional and have always left me with wonderful memories.

I highly recommend this clinic for any health needs your pets may have, and I'm sure they will become clients for many years to come.

Thanks to the whole team for their constant help!
Very professional and friendly, they treat us like a 10 every time we go there!
Great team! They treat their patients as if they were their own family :) A big plus that they put the sedation with you so that our furry friends are calmer!
I want to highlight the excellent care I've received every time I've taken Kala 🐶, as well as the follow-up and concern they've shown after each treatment. Thank you so much for everything! …

The place is excellent technically: they work very efficiently, and the team is generally very attentive. I want to give a special thanks to Alberto, who was extremely empathetic and kind to us. His approach made a huge difference.

Unfortunately, we had a bad communication experience with a veterinarian (named Gala), who was quite abrupt when informing us of our kitten's results. In a pet care service, I believe it's essential to always maintain empathy and sensitivity, both towards the animals and their owners.

Thanks to Alberto's attention and warmth, I decided to give him four stars and leave with a very positive impression of the place. We are very grateful to him ❤️

I am delighted with the professionalism, treatment and attention received from the entire team. Bru has had several health problems and in all cases the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up have been adequate. I wanted to highlight the patience and affection that all the professionals always show.

Beni and I are very happy with the treatment we received at the Veterinarian Clinic. The kindness of all the workers is greatly appreciated. They have always advised me very professionally on the best for my furry friend! Total confidence.

We have a cat, and the service here is spectacular. María, the assistant, and Alberto, the vet, are fantastic, as are the other vets and assistants. This clinic is the only one capable of properly caring for her, as she's a difficult cat to handle. 100% recommended.

I've been to other clinics, but they've never treated me as well as here. I've been taking my dog, Caramelo, there for over a year now, and they've always managed to resolve everything that's happened to her, from allergies to gastrointestinal problems, always with so much love and attention. I also decided to have her spayed there, and I couldn't be happier! Everything went very well, and she has a tiny scar! You can tell when things are done with care, and that's so important when it comes to the health of your furry friend.

Highly professional clinic. The staff is very knowledgeable, and you can feel that from day 1. They render all information in a transparent and honest manner to find the best way forward for pets and owners.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Francisco!
Thank you for your feedback!
This is a clean and modern clinic with friendly staff. Our doctor was Gala. I highly recommend her!
Good service and friendly
They're great!! They help us a lot… and give really good advice… I absolutely recommend them… thank you so much 🙏🏻 …

I've been bringing my cat here since they opened, and they've always provided amazing service. They're incredibly patient, experienced, and caring. They keep up with her every step of the way, and communication with them is always quick. A special mention to Alberto 😊 I can't recommend them enough! …
I want to thank Gala and her entire team for finding out what was wrong with our Kayla and for letting us know that everything turned out alright; without them, it wouldn't have been possible! ❤️
Best veterinary clinic in Barcelona. Highly recommended. 10/10 treatment for all the animals 😊 …
By far the best veterinary clinic in Barcelona. I've been to four or five, and none compare to this one. Gala and Alberto are a 10/10; they have incredible patience with animals.
Thank you very much Adria for your rating!
We went because we had excellent recommendations from a friend, and our expectations were met. If you're looking for a veterinarian in Barcelona, ​​Veterinari del Clínic is highly recommended.
I needed to get my cat's Cexgan certificate and they gave me an appointment immediately; very professional and efficient!

I took my dog ​​in with a foxtail lodged so deep in her ear that they had to sedate her to find it. The vets were excellent, very patient in explaining everything to me, and incredibly kind to my dog. A wonderful experience! Thank you!

Highly recommended. Excellent and personalized service. I will definitely continue to come to Veterinari del Clinic. Thank you so much, Marta and Gala, for your service, kindness, and professionalism!
I am super grateful for the attention and treatment. I went because my cat had dental problems. They operated on him and he is back to being himself, eating more than ever. Highly recommended

I keep writing and deleting this review because there simply aren’t enough words of praise to describe my admiration for this clinic and the wonderful team of people who work here. I did my internship here, and it is truly the most beautiful experience I brought back from Barcelona to Croatia.

The clinic is recognized as a golden cat friendly place — and it truly is. Cats are never stressed; they are handled gently, calming music is played for them, local anesthetic is used before blood draws, soothing pheromones are present in the examination rooms, and so much more.

The expertise of the doctors and veterinary technicians is on an admirable level, but most importantly, it is evident that they put their whole heart into their work. The clinic itself is very tidy and clean, with soft and pleasantly scented bedding for the animals. The approach to clients is professional and extremely courteous — kindness here is truly at the highest level.

Even though I don’t speak Spanish, everyone made an effort to speak to me in English and translate everything for me, which required a lot of extra effort and time.

Dear colleagues, I will forever remember you as the people who showed me that the work of a small clinic can indeed reach an admirable standard without ever neglecting the well-being of our furry patients.

Thank you for everything, from the bottom of my heart. ♡
Thank you so much for your feedback, Marta! We're here for anything you need.
Very professional, decisive and empathetic. The whole team is very friendly and the facilities are always very clean!

Thank you for your feedback!

We're glad to hear you had a positive experience. If you ever need anything, we're here for you.
A highly competent center that provides impeccable care. They assisted us with the euthanasia of our pet, and their treatment and sensitivity were outstanding. Thank you very much.

I didn't want to, but I feel I owe it to Cris, my dog ​​who's no longer with us.
For over two years, I'd been taking my three dogs to this hospital, and well, with Lluna, I spent over €10,000 on tests that ultimately didn't provide the diagnosis they were looking for, surgeries, medication, etc., until I decided to leave her alone because all the time it was just making the animal suffer for nothing. And look, since they left her alone, she's been doing wonderfully 👍. Now, let me tell you what happened with Cris.

Gris was a healthy dog. Marta and Gala took care of her, and in December 2023, they recommended geriatric tests, and she was fine. Then they cleaned her teeth, and in April, she got her vaccinations—everything was fine. But on September 4th, Gris woke up and didn't want to eat, and her breath smelled terrible. I took her to the vet, and Gala stood about a meter away. I measured her distance, and without even looking at her, they told me I had to make an appointment for a dental cleaning. I was annoyed because, as it's true, we didn't have an appointment. I went to pick up her medication, but I didn't like the idea of ​​them asking without even looking at her. That same day, Marta called me to say that before the cleaning, we had to do an echocardiogram because, according to her, the one they did with all the geriatric tests came back slightly abnormal, and without that test, they weren't going to do the cleaning. The total cost was €600. I've always paid what they've asked for, and I'm telling you, I have a bill for over €10,000 between the three dogs. years, but the fact that they didn't even look at her while I was right there didn't sit well with me, and even less so that she had to have an echocardiogram, which had been less than a year since her last one. I told Marta that it wasn't good for me to spend so much money right now, and she told me that she wouldn't operate without the echocardiogram. ((She suggested I pay her in three installments))) Since they told me it was a dental issue, I wasn't too worried ((my fault for that)), but seeing that she was still the same on the 6th, I decided to get a second opinion. On the 9th, she was seen at another vet who, as soon as she arrived, did urine and blood tests and realized it wasn't anything to do with her mouth, but with her kidneys. They immediately started working on it, but it was too late because they had stopped. She was hospitalized, and they did everything they could, but on the 19th, I had to put her down because there was nothing more they could do, and she was in bad shape. You can imagine how awful I felt, and I still am. At first, I didn't want to post anything here. What's more, Marta found out that Cris had passed away on Instagram and immediately called me to ask how. And the next day, Gala, whom I didn't even want to talk to because she kept her at a meter and a half away and didn't even look at her.

And maybe, I'm not sure, but if Cris had been checked, she could be celebrating her 13th birthday with us today, since of the three dogs, she was the healthiest and the one I least expected.
The conclusion I came to from this is that both Marta and Gala are motivated by money, and that hurt me a lot because after spending so much money at their clinic for nothing, when I needed them most, neither of them were there. If this helps any animal, then I'll be satisfied, since they didn't help my Cris.
By the way, we had the echocardiogram they required for the cleaning done less than a year ago, and it was fine. I have proof of everything, including the expenses. Of course I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS HOSTEL, and above all, I do not recommend Gala, who didn't even bother to look at her, nor Marta, who instead of calling me and telling me I had to pay €600 for the ultrasound and cleaning (which she kindly suggested I could pay in two or three installments), should have told me she was bringing her in for a check-up. But no, that doesn't bring in money, and if there's no money involved, they're not interested.
Cris, I owed you this, my girl. I'm so sorry, but I thought you were in the best hands, and I was wrong. If this helps save even one animal, I'll be happy. The photo is from August, and Cris left in September, so you can see she was doing great.
